subject: math
description: Identify possible outliers using the 1.5 x IQR rule and explain their effect on conclusions.
learningObjectives: Identify possible outliers using the 1.5 x IQR rule.
Compute Q1, Q3, IQR, lower fence, and upper fence for an ordered data set.
Explain how an outlier can affect the mean, median, and a statistical conclusion.
Decide whether a possible outlier should be investigated before it is removed or reported.
prerequisites: Order numbers from least to greatest
Find the median of a data set
Write a short explanation using evidence
